commands.description: Configure language, count, sources and times

help:
👋 Welcome to Newsroom

A programming-first newsroom that collects, verifies, summarizes and delivers grounded reports with strong Telegram coverage.

REPORTS
/report — default programming report
/report new — only undelivered stories
/report comprehensive — extended report
/report telegram|x|web|github|reddit — platform-only report
/latest — last delivered report

SETTINGS
/settings — current preferences
/settings language fa|en
/settings count 1..50
/settings schedule HH:MM,HH:MM or off
/settings sources all|telegram,x,web,github,reddit,youtube

SOURCES
/sources — inventory summary
/sources list [type] [page]
/source enable|disable <id>
/source delete <id> confirm — safe archive; history is retained
Upload CSV/XLSX with caption /sources import. Columns: name,type,url,language,category,trust_class,enabled

OPERATIONS
/status · /collect · /schedule

Current: language=en · stories={story_count} · sources={source_scope} · Tehran schedule={schedule}
